en.headline: Standby Signal No. 1 stays; Saudel 410 km east-northeast at 5am
en.dek: Tropical Storm Saudel was estimated near 23.5 degrees north, 117.9 degrees east early Thursday and is forecast to linger over the northeastern South China Sea before turning west.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Standby Signal, No. 1 remained in force on Thursday morning as Tropical Storm Saudel lingered over the northeastern part of the South China Sea.

In a bulletin updated at 4.45am, the Observatory said Saudel was estimated at 5am to be about 410 kilometres east-northeast of Hong Kong, near 23.5 degrees north and 117.9 degrees east, and was slow-moving. Track data around 6am placed the centre near 23.6 degrees north and 117.7 degrees east, about 390 kilometres east-northeast of the territory, with maximum sustained winds near the centre of about 85 kilometres per hour.

The Observatory said Saudel would linger over the northeastern South China Sea this morning before gradually turning westwards and skirting the coast of eastern Guangdong. Under the combined effect of the storm and the northeast monsoon, local winds were occasionally strong offshore and on high ground. The No. 1 signal was expected to remain in force through Thursday morning.

Saudel is forecast to edge closer to the vicinity of the Pearl River Estuary again on Friday, though the Observatory said there were rather large uncertainties in its intensity by then. Forecasters said they would assess the need to issue the Strong Wind Signal, No. 3 if the system approaches the estuary. The public was advised to stay away from the shoreline, stop water sports and keep drains and windows checked.

zh.headline: 一號戒備信號早上維持 沙德爾5時位於東北偏東約410公里
zh.dek: 熱帶風暴沙德爾周四早上在南海東北部掕徊，天文台指一號戒備信號今早維持，稍後評估周五靠近珠江口時會否改發三號強風信號。
body: 香港天文台表示，一號戒備信號周四早上仍然生效，熱帶風暴沙德爾繼續在南海東北部掕徊。
天文台於凌晨4時45分更新的警報指，沙德爾上午5時估計位於本港東北偏東約410公里，即北緯23.5度、東經117.9度附近，移動緩慢。約4e0a午6時的路徑資料顯示，中心約在北緯23.6度、東經117.7度，距離本港東北偏東約390公里，中心附近最高持續風速約每小晈85公里。
天文台預料，沙德爾今早會在南海東北部掕徊，其後逐漸轉西，掠過廣東東部沿岸。受沙德爾與東北季候風共同影響，本港離岸及高地間中吹強風。一號戒備信號預料今早維持。
按照現時預測，沙德爾周五會再度靠近珠江口一帶，但屆時強度存在相當大變數。天文台會密切監察其動向，評估接近珠江口時是否需要改發三號強風信號。市民應遠離岸邊、停止水上活動，並檢查門窗及保持渠道暢通。
